cliff-stair.description: Grand zigzag marble stair for a cliff face. Flights alternate between two z bands so they never stack over each other, landings at each turn on corner columns, balustrades on every flight and landing edge. Starts at the west foot landing and finishes on the east top landing.

cliff-stair-front.description: Symmetric monumental marble switchback stair, 43 m wide x 15 m deep, rising 45 m. A central 7 m flight of 42 worn treads faces the visitor, flanked by four 4.5 m lanes per side that zigzag up to the cliff top, with sloped parapets, copings, newels with bronze urns, ashlar front walls with string courses, cornices and gilded laurel roundels. Hull ramp colliders, landing boxes and rail colliders.
cliff-stair-front.source: const H=9,N=42,XA=-7.3,XB=-6.1,XC=6.3,XD=7.5,T=(XC-XB)/N,R=H/N;const marble={finish:'marble',color:'#ebe2cd',roughness:0.62,surface:{layers:[{kind:'tone',amount:0.35,scale:2},{kind:'grime',amount:0.3},{kind:'moss',amount:0.2,mask:{noise:0.45}},{kind:'edgeWear',amount:0.45}]}};const trim={finish:'marble',color:'#f4eee0',roughness:0.5,surface:{layers:[{kind:'tone',amount:0.25},{kind:'edgeWear',amount:0.5}]}};const band={finish:'stone',color:'#d9ccb0',roughness:0.8};const gold={preset:'gold',color:'#c9a24a',roughness:0.35,metalness:0.9};const bronze={preset:'metal',color:'#6e5a3a',roughness:0.45,metalness:0.8};const conn=['back','front','back','front'];const base=[[-3.5,3.5,1.02,10.02,0],[3.5,8,19.02,10.02,1],[8,12.5,19.02,28.02,2],[12.5,17,37.02,28.02,3],[17,21.5,37.02,46.02,4]];const lanes=[{x0:-3.5,x1:3.5,yF:1.02,yB:10.02,k:0,m:0}];for(const b of base.slice(1)){lanes.push({x0:b[0],x1:b[1],yF:b[2],yB:b[3],k:b[4],m:1});lanes.push({x0:-b[1],x1:-b[0],yF:b[2],yB:b[3],k:b[4],m:-1});}function sf(L,X){if(X<=XB)return L.yF;if(X>=XC)return L.yB;return L.yF+(L.yB-L.yF)*(X-XB)/(XC-XB);}function put(m,c){return m.warp(function(x,y,z){return [z+c,y,-x];});}function poly(pts,d,c){return put(api.extrude(pts.slice().reverse(),d),c);}function omits(L){if(L.k===0)return {l:'back',r:'back'};const inn=conn[L.k-1];const out=L.k<4?conn[L.k]:null;return L.m===1?{l:inn,r:out}:{l:out,r:inn};}function urn(x,y,z){const u=api.lathe([[0.001,0],[0.17,0],[0.21,0.1],[0.3,0.3],[0.27,0.45],[0.16,0.55],[0.21,0.62],[0.001,0.62]],12);api.add(u.translate(x,y,z),bronze);}function parapet(L,latc,X0,X1){const xs=[X0];for(const b of [XB,XC]){if(b>X0+0.01&&b<X1-0.01)xs.push(b);}xs.push(X1);const top=xs.map(function(X){return [X,sf(L,X)+0.95];});const bot=xs.map(function(X){return [X,sf(L,X)-0.3];}).reverse();api.add(poly(top.concat(bot),0.35,latc),trim);const ct=xs.map(function(X){return [X,sf(L,X)+1.09];});const cb=xs.map(function(X){return [X,sf(L,X)+0.95];}).reverse();api.add(poly(ct.concat(cb),0.45,latc),trim);for(let i=0;i<xs.length-1;i++){const pts=[];for(const lat of [latc-0.175,latc+0.175]){for(const X of [xs[i],xs[i+1]]){pts.push(lat,sf(L,X)-0.3,-X,lat,sf(L,X)+1.1,-X);}}api.collider({kind:'hull',points:pts,offset:[0,0,0]});}for(const Xn of [X0+0.28,X1-0.28]){const y=sf(L,Xn);api.add(api.roundedBox(0.5,1.5,0.5,0.03).translate(latc,y+0.6,-Xn),trim);urn(latc,y+1.35,-Xn);}}function rng2(om){return [om==='front'?XB:XA,om==='back'?XC:XD];}for(const L of lanes){const w=L.x1-L.x0,c=(L.x0+L.x1)/2,up=L.yB>L.yF;const pts=[[XA,L.yF],[XB,L.yF]];for(let i=0;i<N;i++){const xa=XB+i*T,xb=XB+(i+1)*T;if(up){const yb=L.yF+(i+1)*R;pts.push([xa,yb]);pts.push([xb,yb]);}else{const ya=L.yF-i*R;pts.push([xb,ya]);pts.push([xb,ya-R]);}}pts.push([XD,L.yB]);pts.push([XD,0]);pts.push([XA,0]);api.add(poly(pts,w,c),marble);const hp=[];for(const xv of [L.x0,L.x1]){hp.push(xv,0,-XB,xv,sf(L,XB)+0.1,-XB,xv,0,-XC,xv,sf(L,XC)+0.1,-XC);}api.collider({kind:'hull',points:hp,offset:[0,0,0]});api.collider({kind:'box',halfExtents:[w/2,L.yF/2,0.6],offset:[c,L.yF/2,6.7]});api.collider({kind:'box',halfExtents:[w/2,L.yB/2,0.6],offset:[c,L.yB/2,-6.9]});const o=omits(L);const rl=rng2(o.l);parapet(L,L.x0+0.175,rl[0],rl[1]);const rr=rng2(o.r);parapet(L,L.x1-0.175,rr[0],rr[1]);}for(const sg of [1,-1]){for(const fr of [[3.5,12.5,19.02],[12.5,21.5,37.02]]){const c=sg*(fr[0]+fr[1])/2,w=fr[1]-fr[0],y=fr[2];api.add(api.box(w,1.0,0.3).translate(c,y+0.5,7.15),trim);api.add(api.box(w+0.1,0.14,0.45).translate(c,y+1.07,7.12),trim);api.collider({kind:'box',halfExtents:[w/2,0.57,0.225],offset:[c,y+0.57,7.1]});api.add(api.box(w,0.45,0.5).translate(c,y-0.22,7.25),trim);const nb=Math.round(y/6);for(let i=1;i<nb;i++){api.add(api.box(w,0.25,0.4).translate(c,i*y/nb,7.3),band);}const yy=y*0.55;api.add(api.torus(1.3,0.12).translate(c,yy,7.38),gold);api.add(api.cylinder(1.18,1.18,0.08,24).rotate(90,0,0).translate(c,yy,7.34),trim);}}return api.build();

cliff-stair-grand.description: Monumental five-flight masonry zigzag stair, 42 m wide, 13 m deep, rising 45 m from y=1 to y=46. Solid stepped marble flights (50 treads each) in adjacent 2.6 m lanes, ashlar landings with caps, sloped parapets with copings, newels with finials and urns, gold laurel roundels, corbel cornice and string-course bands on the retaining faces. Ramp colliders per flight.

cliff-stair-masonry.description: Monumental masonry zigzag stair for a cliff: five solid stepped marble flights in adjacent lanes (each a solid wedge, no pylons) joined by ashlar landings with string courses, sloped balustrade walls with copings, newels and urns. 42 m wide, 13 m deep, 45 m tall, climbs W-E-W-E-W to the cliff top.

cliff-stair-treads.description: Monumental five-flight switchback marble stair, 43 m wide x 15 m deep, rising 45 m from y=1 to y=46. Every flight has 50 real stepped treads (sawtooth profile), sloped parapet walls with coping and posts, ashlar landings with end parapets, newels and urns, and gold laurel roundels on the retaining faces. Ramp hull colliders per flight and box colliders per landing.

cliff-villa.description: Mediterranean hillside townhouse for a terraced cliff town: stone plinth, plastered walls with quoins, string courses and a dentil cornice, arched windows with jambs, hoods, sills and shutters, a central door with pilasters and hood on steps, wrought-iron balconies, tiled roof with overhang, ridge cap, eave boards and chimney. Facade faces +Z.

variant.description: 0 eave to street, 1 gable to street

doric-temple-grand.description: Detailed Doric peripteral temple facing +Z: three-step stylobate, fluted entasis columns with echinus capitals and abaci, honey-stained veined marble, architrave with gilded band, triglyph/metope frieze, cornice, tympanum with relief figures and raking cornices, low tiled gable roof with ribs and ridge, gilded acroteria, ashlar cella with marble antae and gilded door frame.

marble-grand-stair.description: Monumental white marble zig-zag grand stair (two 32 m flights, 131 steps each, east and west landings) with ashlar front, niches, stepped buttresses, balustrades, laurel parapets, bronze braziers and navy banners.

banners.description: navy banners with gold trim on the front wall

braziers.description: bronze braziers with flames on the front parapet piers

honey.description: honey stain colour at joints and edges

marble-house.description: Classical hillside house or treasury: ashlar marble walls on a rubble footing reaching down the slope, pedimented porch of columns, low pale terracotta gable roof with a gilded acroterion; variant 1 adds a set-back upper storey, variant 2 a colonnaded stoa front. Faces +Z.

footing.description: stone footing depth below the floor

marble-temple-hexastyle.description: Classical Greek Doric marble temple facing +Z: hexastyle peristyle of fluted, entasis columns on a three-step crepidoma, triglyph/metope frieze, dentil cornice, relief pediments with acroteria, tiled gabled roof and a cella with door and arched windows.

columns.description: columns on the front; each long side gets 2n-1

height.description: column height (shaft and capital) in meters

honey.description: honey stain colour at joints and base

length.description: overall length of the lowest step in meters

width.description: overall width of the lowest step in meters

sanctuary-massif.description: One organic stepped limestone massif around the lagoon: terraces on meandering contours, broken stratified limestone risers with water streaks between dry olive-ochre treads, a level temple plateau at y 45 and a hill climbing behind it. World coordinates, origin at the lagoon centre.
